summary: This document defines Path Computation Element Communication Protocol (PCEP) extensions for grouping two unidirectional MPLS-TE Label Switched Paths, one in each direction, into an associated bidirectional LSP. It works with a stateful PCE for both PCE-initiated and PCC-initiated LSPs, or a stateless PCE, and applies to LSPs signaled with RSVP-TE.

eli5.summary: One-way streets can be paired into a two-way road. This document gives a path planning protocol a way to say that two one-way paths in opposite directions belong together as a pair.

questions: how to pair two mpls te lsps
